bio: Part wine shop, part café-cum-bistro, this neighbourhood establishment is all things to all people. You enter via a shop packed full of interesting wines, before heading through the restaurant where a glass wine cave takes centre stage. The room has a bistro feel – there are even a few sofas available for those who like it super laid-back – and dishes come in the form of medium-sized plates that are designed for sharing. From sausage soup to cured trout or onion pie, each dish comes with the perfect wine recommendation....
